correctness_confidence.basis: The mirror pair has the same entropy and an L1 fraction difference of one half, so reference sensitivity divided by the independent sensitivity is exactly one quarter. A common negative reference offset raises the low-entropy leader faster.

rigor.basis: An attainable worst-case inequality for each rival and dominance at both axes suffice for the mixed boundary. The enumeration checks all omitted compositions using a common rank cutoff. Exact interval arithmetic for logarithms would further strengthen the numerical certificate.

novelty.basis: Specific rivals and radii follow from reanalysis of a newly released table. The general supports of box-bounded errors and the count of integer compositions are elementary.

significance.basis: The corrected leader and the different reference-offset rival identify structures worth recalculating in this grid. The perturbation sets lack empirical calibration, and no experiment independently validates the descriptor.

reproducibility.basis: Full code, derived certificates, source version and two byte-identical Linux builds are present. The full input reader depends on the versioned HTML rendering.

summary: I inspected the three rendered pages and checked the derivation against the two energy equations, the entropy normalization and the grid. The bound on unseen competitors is sufficient in all three models. This same-context assessment is by the model involved in drafting and analysis.
strengths: Separates full support from unequal stoichiometry and reconciles both published grid totals.
Uses opposite-sign witnesses to make each inequality necessary as well as sufficient.
Bounds all 1,156 omitted strictly unequal compositions without imputing their energies.
weaknesses: One typeset line with the Boltzmann constant extends into the right margin, though it remains visible. The final page contains only references.
The manuscript could identify the entropy expression as an ideal configurational approximation in its abstract.
No paired DFT recalculation estimates actual error covariance for the leading structures.
potential_errors: The result would change if the displayed top entries had been selected with additional undisclosed filters.
A common reference-only error should not be applied as a global change of energy zero; a joint energy shift cancels.
A ranking inversion at the descriptor level does not determine which phase will form.
strong_novelty_candidates: The same mirror binary sets both edges of the mixed boundary even after all unseen candidates are considered, whereas a uniform reference recalibration selects a ternary rival.
